metadata.question: On August 6, 2024 at 1:40 pm local time, did land surface temperatures in Paris exceed 32 degrees Celcius?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Paris, France (approximately 48.8566°N, 2.3522°E) - Date: August 6, 2024, 1:40 PM local time - Paris is in CEST (UTC+2) in August, so 1:40 PM local = 11:40 AM UTC - Collection: Need Land Surface Temperature (LST) data - Best options: MODIS Terra/Aqua LST products or Landsat 8/9 with thermal bands - MODIS has better temporal resolution; Terra passes around 10:30 AM, Aqua around 1:30 PM local time - Landsat 8/9 has 16-day revisit, less likely to have exact date/time match - Will use MODIS Aqua (MYD11A1) as it's closer to 1:40 PM local time 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS LST products have QC bands to filter poor quality pixels - Should apply QC mask to ensure valid LST retrievals - Cloud masking is built into MODIS LST QC 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - LST in Kelvin should be reasonable (e.g., 280-330K for summer in Paris) - 32°C = 305.15K - Valid zero would be impossible for LST (0K = absolute zero) - Check if result is None, NaN, or unreasonable - If no valid pixels after QC, output C2 - If no images found, output C1 ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions paris = ee.Geometry.Point([2.3522, 48.8566]) target_date = '2024-08-06' print(f"Analyzing LST for Paris on {target_date} around 1:40 PM local time") # 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Aqua LST (afternoon overpass ~1:30 PM local) modis_aqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11A1') \ .filterDate(target_date, '2024-08-07') \ .filterBounds(paris) print(f"MODIS Aqua images found: {modis_aqua.size().getInfo()}") if modis_aqua.size().getInfo() == 0: # Try MODIS Terra as fallback modis_terra = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') \ .filterDate(target_date, '2024-08-07') \ .filterBounds(paris) print(f"MODIS Terra images found: {modis_terra.size().getInfo()}") if modis_terra.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No MODIS LST data available for this date.") print("C1") exit() else: collection = modis_terra print("Using MODIS Terra (morning overpass)") else: collection = modis_aqua print("Using MODIS Aqua (afternoon overpass)") # 3. Processing - Get LST and apply QC img = collection.first() # LST_Day_1km band is in Kelvin * 0.02 lst_band = img.select('LST_Day_1km') qc_band = img.select('QC_Day') # Apply scale factor to get Kelvin lst_kelvin = lst_band.multiply(0.02) # Simple QC mask: Keep only good quality pixels (QC bits 0-1 = 00 for good quality) qc_mask = qc_band.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0) lst_masked = lst_kelvin.updateMask(qc_mask) # 4. Check pixel count pixel_count = lst_masked.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=paris.buffer(5000), scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() print(f"Valid pixels after QC: {pixel_count}") if pixel_count == 0: print("No valid pixels after quality control masking.") print("C2") exit() # 5. Calculate mean LST in the area lst_kelvin_mean = lst_masked.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=paris.buffer(5000), scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() if lst_kelvin_mean is None or lst_kelvin_mean != lst_kelvin_mean: print("LST calculation failed (None or NaN).") print("C3") exit() # Convert to Celsius lst_celsius = lst_kelvin_mean - 273.15 print(f"Mean LST: {lst_celsius:.2f}°C ({lst_kelvin_mean:.2f}K)") print(f"Threshold: 32.00°C") print(f"Valid pixels: {int(pixel_count)}") # Validate reasonable range for summer LST if lst_celsius < -50 or lst_celsius > 70: print("LST value outside reasonable range.") print("C3") elif lst_celsius > 32.0: print("LST exceeded 32°C.") print("A") else: print("LST did not exceed 32°C.") print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
paris = ee.Geometry.Point([2.3522, 48.8566])
target_date = '2024-08-06'

print(f"Analyzing LST for Paris on {target_date} around 1:40 PM local time")

# 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Aqua LST (afternoon overpass ~1:30 PM local)
modis_aqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11A1') \
    .filterDate(target_date, '2024-08-07') \
    .filterBounds(paris)

print(f"MODIS Aqua images found: {modis_aqua.size().getInfo()}")

if modis_aqua.size().getInfo() == 0:
    # Try MODIS Terra as fallback
    modis_terra = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') \
        .filterDate(target_date, '2024-08-07') \
        .filterBounds(paris)
    
    print(f"MODIS Terra images found: {modis_terra.size().getInfo()}")
    
    if modis_terra.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print("No MODIS LST data available for this date.")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()
    else:
        collection = modis_terra
        print("Using MODIS Terra (morning overpass)")
else:
    collection = modis_aqua
    print("Using MODIS Aqua (afternoon overpass)")

# 3. Processing - Get LST and apply QC
img = collection.first()

# LST_Day_1km band is in Kelvin * 0.02
lst_band = img.select('LST_Day_1km')
qc_band = img.select('QC_Day')

# Apply scale factor to get Kelvin
lst_kelvin = lst_band.multiply(0.02)

# Simple QC mask: Keep only good quality pixels (QC bits 0-1 = 00 for good quality)
qc_mask = qc_band.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0)
lst_masked = lst_kelvin.updateMask(qc_mask)

# 4. Check pixel count
pixel_count = lst_masked.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=paris.buffer(5000),
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()

print(f"Valid pixels after QC: {pixel_count}")

if pixel_count == 0:
    print("No valid pixels after quality control masking.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

# 5. Calculate mean LST in the area
lst_kelvin_mean = lst_masked.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=paris.buffer(5000),
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()

if lst_kelvin_mean is None or lst_kelvin_mean != lst_kelvin_mean:
    print("LST calculation failed (None or NaN).")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    exit()

# Convert to Celsius
lst_celsius = lst_kelvin_mean - 273.15

print(f"Mean LST: {lst_celsius:.2f}°C ({lst_kelvin_mean:.2f}K)")
print(f"Threshold: 32.00°C")
print(f"Valid pixels: {int(pixel_count)}")

# Validate reasonable range for summer LST
if lst_celsius < -50 or lst_celsius > 70:
    print("LST value outside reasonable range.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif lst_celsius > 32.0:
    print("LST exceeded 32°C.")
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("LST did not exceed 32°C.")
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
